title: The Drive on Moscow
subtitle: The principal opening of Operation Typhoon.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: Army Group Center begins its main offensive toward Moscow, seeking to encircle the Western, Reserve and Bryansk Fronts.
outlineTopics: German strategic objectives for the Moscow offensive.
Hitler's expectations and German command assessments.
The roles of the German field armies and panzer groups.
The planned double encirclement of major Soviet forces.
Soviet command structures and defensive preparations.
The beginning of the main German assault on October 2.
German breakthroughs and the role of mechanized formations.
The importance of Vyazma and Bryansk.
The railway and road networks leading toward Moscow.
German operational strengths and developing logistical weaknesses.
Why capturing Moscow was considered strategically and politically significant.
Simultaneous fighting near Leningrad and in Ukraine.
